notes.title: December Update - Christmas Gifts!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Here's December, Chirstmas, gifts under the tree and so on! So, for you, we decided to make a Content update with Christmas designs!

Architect of the Week - Christmas Gift

To make it special, we decided to give a gift to the player who will won the Architect of the Week Challenge!

In order to take part in this challenge, you need to:
Join our discord here: Discord community
Post your project in our specific channel " #your-creations"
This competition will last until Friday, January 7th 2022.

Be creative, surprise us, and take care of you.
Happy Holidays ♥

notes.title: June's Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today's the day for June's patch, our biggest patch so far!
We added several features we hope you will enjoy, and we expanded the whole playground.

We highly suggest you read the whole patch-note, there are several fixes and useful improvements.

We would like to notify that this is our last (big) patch until our full release on September 2021.
We'll still be keeping an eye out for your feedback & suggestions, and we're always here if you have any trouble.

Take care ♥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774867/3104b5d9acfb7f5196209cf4f83e3e3c160a28d4.png


Career Mode: Teaser Projects
Here it comes! A first taste of the planned Career mode! This new game mode contains three scripted architectural projects to solve in your own way with goals and constraints.
Be aware that this being a teaser, your progression cannot be saved for now.
Be creative Architects!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774867/bed7de2e9d307bfd688b0eae172f4f278a0e5d73.png
Urban Planner
With this feature you'll be able to create projects in way less time than with the Drawing Board! It can also be used as a first step of sorts! Define rules to procedurally generate your projects on a Block, in just a few clicks! Create your own specific presets to quickly create projects on large areas.
Be surprised by the procedural generation of projects!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774867/fa42a78537b9d502a8b41a9168476fb16434d89b.png
Socio-Economic Fabric System
A new way to see the impact of your projects on the city. Solve homelessness! Make the wealthy even wealthier! Or ... don't? Whatever you do will have consequences, one way or another.
This is the way.
Workshop Mods - Upvote System
It is now possible to upvote a Bloc or a Design directly from the game.

notes.title: Avril Update - Modding!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today's the day for our last update of April! 
It's a big one, we added new features we bet you'll enjoy!

Take care.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774867/3104b5d9acfb7f5196209cf4f83e3e3c160a28d4.png

Added Auto Saves and updated save/load panels
Modding
The Modding tool is available! Create, upload, share or use "Designs" created by players around the world, that offer original and innovative architecture to your vision of Paris. You can access it from the Main Menu at any time. You can read our guide here: Modding Tool Guide (Steam)
Hiding Districts
Hiding a district allows you to reduce your CPU/GPU load when several districts are playable. Go to the Strategic Map, select the district you want to hide and click on the same button as to open it (you'll see an icon with an eye). We recommend that people with low specs hardware use it to avoid a downgraded experience.
New Sandbox modes
We added a step that gives you access to 2 modes: Empty Paris (Vacant land only) and Vanilla Paris (previous version).

Hello everyone!

It's time for our first April Update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774867/3104b5d9acfb7f5196209cf4f83e3e3c160a28d4.png

Photo Mode
Welcome to The Photo Mode! It'll enable you to position the game camera in a totally free way in order to choose the framing that suits you. Change the focal length, activate the depth of field, add filters and graphic effects, then sign your image with the logo of your architectural agency.
Show the world what you can make of the city of Paris!
